case: Saratoga Fishing Co. v. J. M. Martinac & Co.
author: Stevens

votes.component: Reverse reviewed resale-based equipment exclusion and implement confined remand

final_joins: Stone, Stevens, Kennedy, Souter, Ginsburg and Breyer directly join the complete classification rule and confined mandate. O'Connor, Scalia and Thomas favor affirmance under the commercial purchaser-bargain boundary; Scalia writes a merits-only dissent at their common scope. O'Connor is not asked to join criticism of the grant or an alternative last-commercial-seller rule. All eight Associate commitments preserve established strict liability, causation, comparative fault and the separate hull/replacement-component rulings; their conflicting classifications are not combined into a Marks holding. No changed ground, new join accommodation or further factual premise is supplied.
global_integration: Pending integrating operator; not claimed complete
